name: smwmusic-pok-mon-x-y-kalos-power-plant
title: Pokémon X/Y - Kalos Power Plant
description:
One of the better songs from this particular Pokémon game. It sounds mildly dramatic and chill. This can probably work in a mechanical level, like a factory. Might even work as a water level theme because of the slow pace of the song. Really anything "indoorsy" will do.

EXTRA NOTE: This is exactly how it was in Idol 9 round 2, except I swapped channels so that the SFX doesn't interrupt the song too much.
